analysis: Frozen models on archived old-policy physical prefixes; sensitivity metrics do not establish reward gain.

source_metadata.history_policy: new-model fixed4 with archived behavior last-actions

units_and_interpretation.action_rates: Fractions, not percentages; change is sensitivity and can improve or worsen an action.
units_and_interpretation.q_direction: L2 distance between unit-length legal-action centered Q vectors, denominator clamped at 1e-6. All depth4-to4 differences are zero by construction; decreasing depth-to4 differences do not establish iterative convergence.
units_and_interpretation.hidden_and_read: L2 difference divided by reference-vector norm, clamped at 1e-6; reference is normal depth4 or normal intervention.
units_and_interpretation.state_update: Actual post-round masked state minus preceding state, normalized by preceding-state norm. M3 context memory is fixed by design, so state updates are zero.
units_and_interpretation.query: Actual query entering each round relative to initial b0. M4/M5 keep b0 by design.
units_and_interpretation.gate: Sigmoid loop-query gate means and coordinate fractions <0.1/>0.9; nonzero gate alone does not show effective state change.
units_and_interpretation.slot_entropy: Before each slot update: per-entity softmax across the four slots (axis=1), Shannon entropy divided by log(4), averaged over unmasked entities. High entropy means diffuse slot competition, not low entity-selection entropy.
units_and_interpretation.slot_geometry: After each slot update: pair cosine averages the six off-diagonal slot pairs; relative spread is ||slots-slot mean||/||slots||.
units_and_interpretation.slot_competition_removed: Same cases/checkpoint: replace slot competition plus entity renormalization by independent per-slot entity softmax; preserve K/V, GRU and FFN. Changes both competition and routing normalization.
units_and_interpretation.uncertainty: Main curves/points summarize each of the three training seeds separately. Behavior seeds, observers and steps are repeated measurements; 2000-resample config+scene clustered intervals condition on the available trained weights. Best/final pairs are one training seed and ten scenes.
units_and_interpretation.compute: Only saved policy_compute fixed4_stats from complete actual fixed4 forward passes. 112 padded entities and 50 padded agent slots are identical across methods. MAC/decision is counted matrix multiplies of this policy path, not FLOPs, latency or diagnostic preview overhead.
units_and_interpretation.best_final: Every checkpoint recomputes its own temporal history from zero using archived real last-actions. Best/final share physical prefixes, but their entering hidden states differ as part of checkpoint behavior; paired shifts do not diagnose reward deterioration causes.
